Bibot v1.0.6 (Build 7) — UI refresh

- Consistent interface: Material Symbols Rounded icons, bold legible text, Bibot blue accent; stable in light and dark mode.
- Cleaner Home: clearer top bar, larger feature tiles, compact banner; layout adapts to landscape.
- Better PDF reading: even side margins, larger reading area, zoom no longer sticks on a page.
- Library scans books from device storage; Weather accepts any location by name or coordinates.
- Gemini chat simplified to two model choices; added STT/TTS engine license credits.
- Settings > Library can add books from device storage using SAF (pick files or a folder). No extra permission, no upload.
